card.title: HAMPSHIRE REGIMENT
card.text: Deployment: Develop CONVOY HX 175, THE DESERT RATS or FORTIFICATION.
card.flavorText: The Hampshire Regiment served in numerous theatres during WWII, continuing a long tradition dating back to its formation in 1881. By 1939, it fielded multiple regular and Territorial Army battalions. The 1st Battalion was deployed to North Africa where it fought in the Tunisia Campaign, and then participated in the Allied invasion of Sicily in 1943. After that, it landed at Salerno during the Italian Campaign and fought northward through arduous mountain battles. The 2nd Battalion, originally stationed in India, was later sent to Burma where it took part in the Arakan operations against Japanese forces. Territorial battalions were deployed across various fronts. Notably, the 7th Battalion landed in Normandy shortly after D-Day, fought through the bocage and took part in the advance into Germany. The regiment earned numerous battle honours, in particular for its role at El Alamein, Monte Cassino and in the Rhine crossings. In 1946, the regiment was granted the “Royal” prefix in recognition of its wartime service. The Royal Hampshire Regiment eventually merged with the Queen's Regiment in 1992 to form the Princess of Wales’s Royal Regiment.
